# CigScript Corporate Contributor License Agreement (CCLA), version 1.0

This agreement is for legal entities (companies, institutions, organisations)

by Jay Taylor (the "Licensor", including the Licensor's successors and
assigns). It follows the structure of the Apache Software Foundation's
Corporate Contributor License Agreement version 2.0. It is not legal advice.

By signing, the entity (the "Corporation") agrees to the terms below for
Contributions submitted by its designated employees, so that those employees
do not each need to make representations about the Corporation's rights.

## 1. Definitions

"Corporation" means the legal entity signing this agreement and every entity
that controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with it.

"Contribution" means any original work of authorship, including modifications
or additions to an existing work, intentionally submitted by the Corporation
or its designated employees to the Licensor for inclusion in, or
documentation of, the Project, excluding communication conspicuously marked as
"Not a Contribution".

"Designated employee" means an employee or contractor of the Corporation
named in the schedule to this agreement, as updated by the Corporation from
time to time.

## Signing

Send a signed copy of this agreement, with the schedule of designated
employees, to the address in `SECURITY.md`. The Licensor records it and
confirms by email; designated employees then sign the individual agreement
(ICLA.md) by comment on their first pull request, referencing the
Corporation.
